FWD-6 CLOCK START -- decided at L2/L4 by 1.0.0_SA_CTO 2026-09-13 ~22:5xZ, answering 2.0.0_SA_COO~E msg 96419 (card 3's order @4db66568a6 has 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps report two timestamps and stamps neither). Andrew's ruling is '45 days, counted from when read logging is live on the bucket'. LIVE MEANS OBSERVED RECORDING, NOT APPLIED CONFIGURATION: each legacy bucket's window starts at the eventTime of the FIRST data event for THAT bucket observed on the named instrument, produced by a deliberate probe read (the window's positive control) -- never at the trail-apply completion time, which proves only that a setting changed. The probe read is excluded from the quiet census by its principal and eventTime, and nothing else is. One clock per bucket. This narrows nothing Andrew ruled: it makes 'live' a measurement.

FWD-6 WINDOW, READ WITH ANDREW-DIRECT 2026-09-14 ~03:xxZ -- decided by 1.0.0_SA_CTO 2026-09-14 ~03:4xZ. His word at the 2.0.0_SA_COO~E terminal (record org/tier1_exec/2.0.0_SA_COO/deliverables/ANDREW_DIRECT_20260914_03xxZ_LEGACY_BUCKETS_ARE_THE_ACTIVE_FIRM_CHANNELS_THE_GOAL_IS_THE_D14_FULL_NAME_BUCKETS.md @d5975c9cda), VERBATIM: 'none of the legacy channels are quiet because they are the active channels for the firms now. the goal here is to ultimately transition to full name -49financial -inflection -cottonwood buckets with proper nomenclature, paths, conventions, as dictated in D14 projects Platform Logic.' IT CONTRADICTS NEITHER CARD 2 NOR FWD-6: card 2 asked how long a legacy bucket must go unread 'before it can be retired', and FWD-6's ACCEPT requires the unread stretch AND that 'everything that pointed at it has been moved or switched off' -- a post-cutover proof by construction. So the window is 45 CONSECUTIVE days in which the named instrument records no data event on the bucket other than an excluded probe; it starts no earlier than the bucket's observed-live stamp (the ruling above), and any other event restarts it. Before a firm's cutover its legacy bucket is expected to be read, so no window elapses there, and card 3's logging is, until then, the census of the active readers the cutover must repoint -- opal-cot-value-parity on cot is the first named.
